report.summary: 4 findings reviewed: 1 confirmed (incomplete-shell-spec, low severity), 3 narrowed (leaky-detection-mismatch, undefined-symbols, unguarded-cleanup-race, each high severity). All require code inspection to settle.
risks: If ceiling.py excludes leaky layers but graph_delta includes them, mutations affecting only leaky layers would be missed by ceiling but caught by graph_delta, leading to inconsistent detection.
If symbols _REASON_MAP, evidence_ref, _deep_only_modules, _tail_matches, DEEP_EDGE_MARK are truly undefined, NameError will occur at runtime.
If eval main does not wait for process termination before cleanup, race condition can cause resource leaks or crashes.
If reach.py does not catch SyntaxError for non-Python files, shell scripts could cause unhandled exceptions.
todos: Inspect ceiling.py for handling of leaky layers and compare with graph_delta.detected_leaky.
Grep for undefined symbols in session.py and graph_brief.py full files.
Inspect eval/__main__.py for synchronization before cleanup.
Verify reach.py catches SyntaxError for non-Python files.
Document findings and close each item with settling check results.

items.title: Settle leaky-detection-mismatch by inspecting ceiling.py and graph_delta.py
items.why_now: High severity: if ceiling's clean arm excludes leaky layers, mutations moving only leaky layers would be undetected by ceiling but caught by graph_delta, creating a detection gap.

steps.do: Inspect ceiling.py's handling of leaky layers; check if it filters out leaky movements from detection count.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'leaky' daedalus/eval/ceiling.py; read full file to confirm logic.

steps.do: Inspect graph_delta.py's detected_leaky property to see what layers it includes.
Compare the two: does ceiling's clean arm exclude layers that graph_delta's detected_leaky includes?
steps.verified_by: Manual comparison of logic from steps 1 and 2.

items.assumption: Full files of ceiling.py and graph_delta.py are available for inspection.

items.title: Settle undefined-symbols by grepping session.py and graph_brief.py
items.why_now: If symbols are truly undefined, NameError will occur at runtime, breaking council session and graph brief generation.

steps.do: Grep for _REASON_MAP and evidence_ref in full session.py.
Grep for _deep_only_modules, _tail_matches, DEEP_EDGE_MARK in full graph_brief.py.
If any symbol is missing, add definition or fix reference.
steps.verified_by: Python module imports successfully without NameError.

items.assumption: Full files are available; missing symbols, if any, need to be defined.

items.title: Settle unguarded-cleanup-race by inspecting eval/__main__.py
items.why_now: Race condition can cause resource leaks or crashes if cleanup proceeds before child process terminates.

steps.do: Inspect eval/__main__.py for order of operations after run_gate: is there a wait/join before cleanup?
steps.verified_by: Read lines around run_gate call and subsequent cleanup; confirm synchronization.

steps.do: If no synchronization exists, add wait for process termination before cleanup.
steps.verified_by: Test with long-running subprocess; cleanup occurs only after process exits.

items.assumption: Full file of eval/__main__.py is available.

items.title: Settle incomplete-shell-spec by verifying reach.py handles non-Python files
items.why_now: Low severity: shell LanguageSpec is complete, but reach.py may still mishandle non-Python files if it doesn't catch SyntaxError.

steps.do: Check if reach.py's _scan function catches SyntaxError when parsing non-Python files.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'SyntaxError\|except' daedalus/mapping/reach.py; confirm try-except around ast.parse.

steps.do: If not, add try-except to safely skip non-Python files.
steps.verified_by: Running reach on a repo with shell scripts completes without error; shell scripts are skipped.
